svg.title: Super Agent vs Personal Agent
svg.desc: Recreated diagram showing the progression from agent harness to personal agent to super agent; two mention designs; personal and team workflows; and shared memory. All readable diagram content and workflow connections from the reference are retained. The obscured title suffix, editor controls, cursor, and watermark are excluded.

g.text: From agent harness to super agent
always on, one ticket per job
a team’s queue · one router · many workers
Still feels like chat: you start most of the work.
Shared Memory (shared brain): decisions, people, projects
